reportedByOwner: GA4 Realtime not visible and ads absent after cutover
rootCause: Shared integration loader set crossorigin=anonymous on Funding Choices CMP, whose200 response has no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. Browser blocks CMP before consent can unblock GA4 and ads.
priorVerificationCorrection: Earlier ERR_FAILED was incorrectly attributed to managed browser network restrictions. Playwright route fulfillment/Node relay bypassed normal CORS enforcement and was insufficient evidence of direct visitor delivery.
change: Use classic no-cors script only for CMP; keep anonymous CORS for other Google integrations.
regression: Synthetic browser tests assert CMP script has no crossorigin; consent deny/grant/revoke and filled/unfilled/blocked ads all pass. Added these scenarios to CI using platform-available Chromium.
